statement: Clearing Wave 125 in the Pet Arena can be made easier but still has RNG factors.
Play a Hunter with the Beastmaster talent to get the Arena Spirit buff for entering the Arena multiple times in a 10-minute window.
Arena Spirit buff lets you enter the Arena multiple times during a 10-minute time frame.
Arena Spirit buff is usually enough to attempt the wave 2-3 times.
The Beastmaster talent also gives a passive +15% Pet Damage.
Wedding Cake meal gives a passive to Pet Damage; he has 20% more Pet Fighting Damage from it.
Another meal also gives more Pet Fighting Damage.
The Electrolyte vial in Alchemy gives quite a boost to Pet Damage.
Using these damage bonuses helps do more damage and limits RNG slightly.
Borger's active ability is useless and can hurt because the Refiller may prioritize filling Borger instead of Badumdum or Looter.
Borger's main purpose is as a tank.
Refiller's ability gives a 5-second buff that refills a random ability whenever a non-basic attack lands.
With the Rattler and Looter the Refiller can refill all three abilities as fast as possible.
Refiller is only really useful until about 300-400 Badumdum stacks then becomes less of a priority.
Still use Refiller as much as possible without limiting Rattler and Looter Chest output.
Badumdum is what everything revolves around; it builds attack speed.
Each Badumdum stack increases Basic Attack Speed.
Badumdum only refreshes when a Basic Attack lands on an enemy.
Refiller is needed early game to refresh Badumdum more often.
Looter provides sustain and survivability by healing the pet via Forager Breedability and Miasma buffs.
Defender and Shell buffs also help sustain the team.
Attack speed and refilling are needed to refresh Looter often for more sustain.
Rattler is where all of the damage comes from.
Do not start using Rattler's ability until around Wave 50-60.
Using Rattler's ability too early clears waves too fast so you can't get enough Badumdum stacks before pets get one-shot.
Clearing Wave 125 unlocks the sixth Pet Slot.
Sixth pet slot is really helpful for clearing later waves in Pet Territory battles.
